description: Analyze spin density of the ZnO wurtzite (100) surface. This is a negative control for clean surfaces.
user_prompt: Perform spin density analysis on the ZnO (100) surface (wurtzite structure, P6_3mc). Determine whether the system has unpaired electrons. If unpaired electrons are present, identify the atom carrying the majority of the spin density by its element and report its magnetic moment; otherwise report that there is no spin-carrying element and report the maximum residual site magnetic moment.
